cd /tmp
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ | sed -n 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
echo "=== attributes_cable_type ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/attributes_cable_type/" -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" | head -c 500
echo; echo "=== WFS3 proxy ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "wfs3:%{http_code}\n" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/wfs3/"
echo "=== logs endpoint ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "logs:%{http_code}\n" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/logs/"
